effect.zh: 效果
effect.en: Effect

effect.zh: 在接下來 1 分鐘開始時擲本表；若再次擲出此結果，忽略之。
effect.en: At the start of each of your turns for the next minute, roll on this table. Ignore this result on subsequent rolls.

effect.zh: 你在下一分鐘內施放的下一個傷害法術，傷害骰視為擲出最大值。
effect.en: The next damaging spell you cast within the next minute deals maximum damage.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放 3 環火球術。
effect.en: Cast fireball as a 3rd-level spell centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放 5 環魔法飛彈。
effect.en: Cast magic missile as a 5th-level spell.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放困惑術。
effect.en: Cast confusion centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你在每個回合開始時恢復 5 點生命值。
effect.en: Regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns for the next minute.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放變形術；若豁免失敗，你變成綿羊。
effect.en: Cast polymorph on yourself; on a failed save, you become a sheep.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你可用附贈動作傳送至 20 呎內可見的未佔據空間。
effect.en: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see as a bonus action.

effect.zh: 你長出由羽毛構成的鬍鬚，並在打噴嚏時脫落。
effect.en: You grow a beard made of feathers that falls out when you sneeze.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放油膩術。
effect.en: Cast grease centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，生物對你下一個施放的法術進行豁免時具有劣勢。
effect.en: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast within the next minute.

effect.zh: 你的皮膚變為藍色；解除詛咒術可結束此效果。
effect.en: Your skin turns blue. A remove curse spell ends this effect.

effect.zh: 你的額頭長出第三隻眼；接下來 1 分鐘，所有依賴視覺的感知（觀察）檢定具有優勢。
effect.en: A third eye appears on your forehead. For the next minute, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你施放時間為 1 動作的法術可改為附贈動作施放。
effect.en: For the next minute, spells with a casting time of 1 action can be cast as a bonus action.

effect.zh: 你傳送至 60 呎內可見的未佔據空間。
effect.en: Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

effect.zh: 直到你下個回合結束前，你被傳送至星界位面；之後回到原本空間，或最近的未佔據空間。
effect.en: You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, then return to your former space or the nearest unoccupied space.

effect.zh: 使一個隨機生物在接下來 1 小時內陷入恐慌。
effect.en: A random creature is frightened for the next hour.

effect.zh: 你的年齡增加或減少 1d10 年（由 DM 決定）。
effect.en: Your age changes by 1d10 years, as determined by the DM.

effect.zh: 你附近 60 呎內出現 1d6 隻由 DM 控制的飄浮水母；牠們受驚並盡快逃離。
effect.en: 1d6 DM-controlled flumphs appear within 60 feet of you, frightened and fleeing as quickly as possible.

effect.zh: 你恢復 2d10 點生命值。
effect.en: Regain 2d10 hit points.

effect.zh: 直到你下個回合開始前，你變成一盆植物；仍具意識，但陷入失能且所有傷害易傷。
effect.en: Until the start of your next turn, you become a potted plant: conscious but incapacitated and vulnerable to all damage.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你在每個回合開始時傳送至 20 呎內的隨機未佔據空間。
effect.en: For the next minute, teleport to a random unoccupied space within 20 feet at the start of each turn.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放浮空術。
effect.en: Cast levitate on yourself.

effect.zh: 你附近 5 呎內出現一隻由 DM 控制的獨角獸；1 分鐘後消失。
effect.en: A DM-controlled unicorn appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you and disappears after 1 minute.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你無法說話；每當嘗試說話時，口中飄出粉紅色泡泡。
effect.en: For the next minute, you cannot speak. Pink bubbles float from your mouth whenever you try.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，一面幽靈盾牌漂浮在你附近，使你的 AC 獲得 +2 加值。
effect.en: For the next minute, a spectral shield floats nearby and grants you a +2 bonus to AC.

effect.zh: 接下來 5d6 天，你對酒精的醉酒效果免疫。
effect.en: You are immune to the intoxicating effects of alcohol for the next 5d6 days.

effect.zh: 你的頭髮全部脫落，並在 24 小時內重新長出。
effect.en: All your hair falls out and grows back within 24 hours.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你的視線變得明亮；任何看見你眼睛的生物都會暫時失明。
effect.en: For the next minute, your eyes shine brightly; creatures that see them are briefly blinded.

effect.zh: 你恢復一個最低環級、已消耗的法術位。
effect.en: Regain one expended spell slot of the lowest level available.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，每當你說話時都必須大喊。
effect.en: For the next minute, you must shout whenever you speak.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放迷霧術。
effect.en: Cast fog cloud centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 你可見、30 呎內至多三個生物各受到 4d10 閃電傷害。
effect.en: Up to three creatures you can see within 30 feet each take 4d10 lightning damage.

effect.zh: 直到你下個回合結束前，你被最近的生物恐懼。
effect.en: You are frightened by the nearest creature until the end of your next turn.

effect.zh: 你周圍 30 呎內的每個生物，接下來 1 分鐘隱形；攻擊或施法會使其隱形結束。
effect.en: Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes invisible for 1 minute; attacking or casting a spell ends the invisibility.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你對所有傷害具有抗性。
effect.en: You have resistance to all damage for the next minute.

effect.zh: 60 呎內一個隨機生物中毒 1d4 小時。
effect.en: A random creature within 60 feet is poisoned for 1d4 hours.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你發出明亮光芒；在你 5 呎內結束回合的生物會暫時失明。
effect.en: For the next minute, you emit bright light; creatures ending their turns within 5 feet of you are briefly blinded.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放變形術；若豁免失敗，你變成山羊。
effect.en: Cast polymorph on yourself; on a failed save, you become a goat.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，幻象蝴蝶與花瓣在你周圍 5 呎內飄舞。
effect.en: Illusory butterflies and flower petals flutter within 5 feet of you for the next minute.

effect.zh: 你立刻獲得一個額外動作。
effect.en: You immediately gain one additional action.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，生物對你下一個施放的法術進行豁免時具有劣勢。
effect.en: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast within the next minute.

effect.zh: 你在自己身上施放鏡影術。
effect.en: Cast mirror image on yourself.

effect.zh: 你在 60 呎內一個隨機生物身上施放飛行術。
effect.en: Cast fly on a random creature within 60 feet.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你隱形；攻擊或施法會使隱形結束。
effect.en: You become invisible for the next minute; attacking or casting a spell ends the invisibility.

effect.zh: 若你在接下來 1 分鐘內死亡，會立刻依復生術效果重獲生命。
effect.en: If you die within the next minute, you immediately return to life as if by the reincarnate spell.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你的體型增大一個尺寸類別。
effect.en: Your size increases by one category for the next minute.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你與周圍 30 呎內所有生物對穿刺傷害易傷。
effect.en: For the next minute, you and all creatures within 30 feet are vulnerable to piercing damage.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你周圍環繞著微弱的空靈音樂。
effect.en: Faint ethereal music surrounds you for the next minute.

effect.zh: 你恢復所有已消耗的術法點。
effect.en: Regain all expended sorcery points.
